verdict.rationale: GitCafe's own docs index lists milestones alongside issues and labels as a way to track work, so grouping issues into milestones is a documented capability. The evidence is a single one-line mention, though, and nothing confirms that milestones carry due dates. missing for 10: evidence that milestones support due dates, in-depth milestone documentation (assigning issues, progress tracking), independent or hands-on corroboration
